goal.name: Frontend Development
goal.valid_for: HTML5, CSS3, modern JavaScript (ES2025), React 19, TypeScript 5
goal.video_language_note: English: short topic videos from Kevin Powell, Web Dev Simplified, Bro Code, Fireship and others. Hindi: CodeWithHarry (Sigma Web Development) and Chai aur Code.
career_outcomes: Build accessible, responsive websites with HTML and CSS
Write modern JavaScript and work with APIs
Build, test and deploy React + TypeScript apps
Use Git, npm, Vite and Tailwind like a professional
Portfolio of 4 deployed projects for Frontend / UI Developer roles
goal.resource_policy: Links only to free, legal sources (official docs, open-licence books, reputable free platforms, public YouTube videos). No copyrighted material re-hosted. YouTube videos are never paywalled or ad-gated.

estimated_hours.note: Beginner to job-ready planning estimate. Video minutes are estimates until the link checker fills real durations (+15% rule applied in-app).
